value.rationale: An exact all-split dependence law for two standard two-sample rank-test magnitudes, including sharp perfect-correlation singleton boundary and universal nonzero interior asymptotic correlation. It reveals material nonlinear dependence invisible to the signed Wilcoxon–CvM covariance, relevant to combined-test null calibration. No claim is made about combined-test tails or power.
